description: Between-set rest timer with superset-aware rest logic. Files: WorkoutLoggingView.swift, SetRowView.swift, WorkoutLoggingViewModel.swift

title: Template Day Scheduling
description: Day-of-week picker per training block for mesocycle templates. Files: CreateMesocycleView.swift, MesocycleViewModel.swift

title: Plate Calculator
description: Plate loading calculator for barbell exercises. Files: PlateCalculatorView

title: Workout Sharing / Export
description: Share functionality for workouts. No share exists currently. Shared module has PDF/CSV exporters but they're analytics-focused. Files: New WorkoutShareView, integration with Modules/Shared/Export/

title: Exercise Video/Image Integration
description: Exercise entity has videoURL/imageURL fields but ALL 200+ seeded exercises have nil. No media displayed anywhere. Files: All exercise seed files, ExerciseRowView.swift, new video player component

title: Training Goal Selection in Mesocycle
description: CreateMesocycleView hardcodes goal to hypertrophy. TrainingGoal enum has 4 cases but user cannot select one. Files: CreateMesocycleView.swift

description: WorkoutLoggingView shows 'kg' but MesocycleDetailView shows 'lbs'. App convention is American units (lbs). Both should use the user's preferred unit system.

title: RPE gap: WorkoutSetData DTO doesn't carry RPE
description: WorkoutSetData DTO doesn't carry RPE even though WorkoutSet entity supports it. RPE data is lost during DTO conversion.

title: Superset / Circuit / Giant Set Support

title: Personal Records (PRs) Tracking

title: Custom Exercise Creation UI
description: Custom exercise creation with edit/delete support. Files: ExerciseLibraryView.swift, ExerciseLibraryViewModel.swift

title: Workout Detail / Review View
description: Full set/weight review view for completed workouts. Files: WorkoutDetailView.swift, WorkoutHistoryView.swift

title: Per-Exercise Progressive Overload Charts
description: Weight/volume/1RM charts via ExerciseLibrary. Files: ExerciseProgressView.swift, ExerciseLibraryView.swift, GetExerciseHistoryUseCase.swift

title: Live Workout Duration Timer
description: Live-updating duration timer during workouts. Files: WorkoutLoggingView.swift

title: Estimated 1RM Calculation
description: 1RM calculation with historical PR comparison. Files: WorkoutSet extension, SetRowView.swift, WorkoutHistoryContentView.swift

title: Per-Set Notes
description: Optional notes field on individual sets. Files: WorkoutSet.swift, WorkoutSetModel.swift, SetRowView.swift

title: Nutrition Domain
description: All nutrition features: food search, logging, macros, water tracking, meal templates, API integration

title: Food Favorites
description: Toggle button and favorites section in food search. Files: FoodResultRowView.swift, FoodSearchView.swift

title: Nutrition Streak / Consistency Tracking
description: Track consecutive days of logging or hitting macro goals. Gamification motivates consistent logging. Files: New calculation from DailyNutrition history, streak counter UI

title: Weekly/Monthly Nutrition Summary
description: MacroDetailSheet shows 7-day trends. Extend with average daily intake, goal adherence %, best/worst days. Files: New summary view, data from NutritionRepository.getFoodEntries(from:to:)

title: Multi-Serving Size Units
description: Quantity input hardcodes grams. Food.servingUnit exists but QuantityInputView doesn't use it. Files: QuantityInputView.swift (unit picker), conversion logic

title: Food Entry Notes
description: Optional annotation on entries (e.g., 'pre-workout meal'). Minor but adds context. Files: FoodEntry.swift, FoodEntryModel.swift, QuantityInputView.swift

title: Nutritionix Common Foods Support
description: NutritionixAPI.search() skips common foods (only returns branded). Code has a comment about needing additional requests. Files: NutritionixAPI.swift

title: Persistent Disk Cache for Food Search
description: FoodCache is in-memory only -- lost on app restart. Could persist to SwiftData or UserDefaults. Files: FoodCache.swift, potentially new persistence layer

title: FoodEntryModel doesn't store food name
description: FoodEntryModel doesn't store food name -- entry rows show quantity/macros but not the food name. Should store name on entry or fetch via repository lookup.

title: Configure Nutritionix API keys (placeholder DEMO_KEY)
description: Food APIs have placeholder keys that need to be configured. NutritionixAPI.swift has YOUR_APP_ID/YOUR_APP_KEY, USDAFoodAPI.swift has DEMO_KEY. Food search fails or is rate-limited until proper keys are set.

title: Recent/Frequent Foods
description: Recent and frequent foods with sort options. Files: FoodSearchView.swift, LogFoodUseCase

title: Custom Food Creation
description: Custom food creation flow with full macro entry. Files: CreateCustomFoodView.swift, FoodSearchView.swift

title: Water Tracking
description: Manual water logging with daily goals, use cases, and delete entry support. Files: WaterEntry entity/model, NutritionTabContentView.swift, LogWaterUseCase

title: Micronutrient Display (Fiber/Sugar)
description: End-to-end micronutrient display: entity → model → use case → DI → UI. Files: FoodResultRowView.swift, FoodLoggingView.swift, NutritionTabContentView.swift

title: Edit Food Entry Quantity
description: Swipe-to-edit with proportional macro recalculation. Files: UpdateFoodEntryUseCase.swift, FoodLoggingViewModel.swift, MealSectionView.swift

title: Quick Re-Log from History
description: Swipe-to-relog using current date. Files: FoodLoggingViewModel.swift, MealSectionView.swift

title: Meal Templates / Saved Meals
description: Save a complete meal (e.g., 'My usual breakfast') and log all items at once. High value for routine meals but significant scope. Files: New MealTemplate entity/model, repository, use case, template management view, 'log from template' flow

title: Copy Previous Day's Meals
description: Duplicate all entries from previous day. Simple implementation using existing use cases in a loop. Files: NutritionTabContentView.swift, new action using GetFoodEntriesUseCase + LogFoodUseCase

title: Shared / Cross-Domain
description: Cross-domain features: Today Dashboard, CloudKit, widgets, Watch app, analytics, export, accessibility, design system, onboarding, notifications

title: Today Dashboard - Wire Navigation
description: Quick action tab navigation from Today Dashboard. Files: TodayDashboardView.swift

title: iOS Widgets (WidgetKit)
description: Not implemented. Today Dashboard data model is widget-ready. Needs WidgetKit extension + App Group shared container. Files: New widget extension target

title: Apple Watch Companion App
description: Not implemented. Workout logging and recovery glances are natural Watch features. Files: New watchOS target

title: Export Format Enhancement
description: PDFExporter generates plain text PDFs (just drawText calls, no colors/charts/branding). No JSON export option. Files: PDFExporter.swift, CSVExporter.swift

title: Onboarding - TDEE / Goal Setup Step
description: Onboarding has 3 steps (Welcome, Profile, HealthKit). CalculateTDEEUseCase exists but isn't used during onboarding. Users must find settings post-onboarding. Files: OnboardingCoordinator.swift, new GoalSetupView

title: Cross-Domain Protocol Conformance
description: WorkoutDataProviding, NutritionDataProviding, HealthDataProviding, UserProfileProviding defined but repositories may not actually conform to them. Analytics uses full repository types directly. Files: Repository implementations, Analytics use cases

title: Dynamic Type Support
description: Typography uses fixed-size fonts. No @ScaledMetric or DynamicTypeSize support. Files: Typography.swift, views using typography tokens

title: Data Import from Other Apps
description: Only export exists. Users from Strong, MyFitnessPal, Hevy have no import path. Files: New CSV/JSON importer

title: PDF Export - Exercise Name Resolution
description: PDFExporter.exportWorkoutLog displays exerciseId.uuidString.prefix(8)... instead of actual exercise names. Files: PDFExporter.swift

title: App Theme Selection
description: No System/Light/Dark toggle in settings. No .preferredColorScheme() override. Files: SettingsView.swift, app-level color scheme state

title: Data Backup/Restore
description: No manual backup beyond CloudKit. Users lose all data on uninstall. Files: New backup/restore flow, SwiftData store export

title: Today Dashboard - Date Navigation
description: Date navigation in Today Dashboard. Files: TodayDashboardView.swift

title: Haptic Feedback Standardization
description: AnalyticsDashboardView uses haptics but TodayDashboardView has none. Should be standardized in design system. Files: Design system haptic utility, all interactive views

title: Improve PDF export quality (branding, charts, color)
description: PDFs are text-only with system fonts. No branding, charts, or color. Nearly unusable for sharing. Needs design improvements to make exports presentable.

title: Today Dashboard - Recovery/Strain Score Integration
description: Recovery and strain score integration in Today Dashboard. Files: TodayDashboardView.swift, TodayDashboardViewModel.swift

title: Design System V1/V2 Consolidation
description: V2 documented as premium theme for TodayDashboard, V1 adaptive tokens remain standard. Files: Colors.swift

title: Goal Achievement Notifications
description: 3 new notification types: goalAchievement, streakMilestone, personalRecord. Files: NotificationType.swift

title: Accessibility (VoiceOver)
description: Labels, hints, values added across all domains (wellness, workout, nutrition, shared). Files: ~15 presentation views across all modules

title: CloudKit Sync
description: VitalArcApp.swift line 54 explicitly disables CloudKit: cloudKitDatabase: .none. All data local-only. Significant gap for multi-device users. Files: VitalArcApp.swift, CKRecord mappings for all SwiftData models

title: Workout-Nutrition Correlation Analysis
description: GenerateProgressReportUseCase fetches both domains but doesn't correlate. Cross-domain protocols already in place. Files: New correlation use case in Analytics, cross-domain protocol usage

title: Sleep-Recovery-Performance Insights
description: Recovery and strain calculated independently. No generated insights like 'Your recovery drops after >15 strain.' Files: New GenerateInsightsUseCase in Analytics

title: Remove legacy ChartView.swift and MetricCardView.swift
description: ChartView.swift and MetricCardView.swift are marked legacy but still in codebase. Should be removed if fully replaced.
